onDemand: On demand; no automatic AI requests
contextHelp: Only the bounded sources marked “Will send” go to the Writer. Review POV, story time and text for unauthorized secrets. Plans, references and beliefs are not committed facts.
previousPaths: Earlier chapter paths, one per line
queries: Earlier-text search terms, up to three lines
authorSource: Original source: author view, never sent as Writer input
basis_PLAN_NOT_FACT: Chapter intent, not an occurred fact
basis_PUBLIC_TEXT_NOT_ACTOR_KNOWLEDGE: Earlier text, not a character knowledge grant
warning_CHARACTERS_TRIMMED: Many participants: a bounded selection is used; adjust manually.
warning_SUSPICION_TEXT_UNKNOWN: Some suspicions lack safe wording; author truth was not substituted.
warning_POV_UNKNOWN_NO_PRIVATE_KNOWLEDGE: POV is unknown; no private actor knowledge was included.
warning_PREVIOUS_DRAFT_NOT_COMMITTED: Some earlier text is uncommitted and remains text reference only.
warning_PREVIOUS_STORY_TIME_UNKNOWN_OR_F: Earlier text with unknown or later story time was excluded.
sceneHelp: Start with a sentence about the scene goal. Add motivation, conflict, emotion and style as needed. Select or combine beats before requesting a paragraph candidate.
scenePlaceholder: Example: two friends clash over values yet leave room for cooperation. Show conflict through choices and consequences.
confirmBeats: Confirm these beats and draft a paragraph
notSavedToManuscript: This candidate has not been written to the manuscript.
inspirationLimit: Select 1–20,000 characters to save as inspiration.
inspirationSaved: Saved to this project’s inspiration inbox; Canon is unchanged.
notCanon: AI candidate for author review, not Canon.
factsHelp: Extract candidates only from the actual current text. Edit, accept or reject each one. Quotes can be located; accepting a candidate is not a State Commit.
staleFacts: The manuscript changed. This report is read-only evidence; extract again before handoff.
reviewSaved: Author review saved. Canon, State and Knowledge are unchanged.
stateGate: Handoff requires matching text with a valid semantic Final witness. Proposed Diff, semantic review, Validation and an explicit author State Commit still apply. The next chapter reads committed state only.
memoryPrepared: The Memory task ended. Inspect the proposal and validation in the formal workflow; no automatic Commit occurred.
taskStarted: Submitted; waiting for actual task events
saveFirst: Draft save requested. Confirm it succeeded before refreshing context or submitting a task.
confirmContextFirst: Open Writing context, review and approve the current packet first.
styleFromContext: Style from the approved context packet
basis_CURRENT_DRAFT_NOT_STATE: Current manuscript, not automatically actor knowledge or State
warning_STORY_TIME_UNKNOWN_CHAPTER_CUTOF: Story time is unknown. Only committed chapter order was used; no timestamp was invented.
warning_AMBIGUOUS_CHARACTER_NAME: Duplicate character names are kept as separate IDs. Exclude unrelated people; no identity merge is inferred.
actionsHelp: Save this project’s action, requirements and candidate directions. Loading fills the form; review before generating. Models, context permissions and Canon stay unchanged.
saveWritingAction: Save current requirements as an action
noWritingActions: Save your frequent dialogue, tightening or voice requirements for reuse.
defaultActionPolicy: Uses the existing action’s default safety policy
candidateHistoryHelp: Recover saved candidates for this document without another model call. Handled or stale records are read-only; acceptance still uses the existing revision checks.
noCandidateHistory: No co-writing candidates for this document yet.
readOnlyCandidateHistory: This record is handled or its source changed. View, copy or save inspiration; it cannot overwrite the current manuscript.
contextScopeSaved: Context choices saved. Reopening restores the choices, but still requires a fresh Writer safety review.
contextScopeRestored: Previous choices restored; sending to Writer is not approved yet.
lookupLimit: Select a character or setting name of 1–120 characters.
lookupHelp: Search this project’s existing records and manuscript index locally, without AI. This is author view: mentions do not prove presence or grant character knowledge.
lookupAmbiguous: Multiple names, aliases or confirmed targets match. Choose explicitly; no identity was merged or inferred.
lookupUnsaved: Looking up a name in unsaved text. This does not save prose, links or Canon.
noExactEntity: No exact record match. No person is guessed and no link is created.
compareChapterSide: Read this chapter on the right
noRelatedMentions: No literal mentions of this name were found in other manuscript files.
basis_AUTHOR_SELECTED_HYPOTHESIS_NOT_CAN: Author-selected conditional hypothesis, not an occurred fact
warning_HISTORICAL_TIME_UNKNOWN_NO_RUNTI: Flashback/flashforward without explicit story time: runtime State, historical character knowledge and prior prose are withheld. Enter a timezone-aware time and refresh.
warning_TASK_CRITICAL_REFERENCE_BUDGET_E: The budget excluded a current goal, text, knowledge or style source. Review the sent list, remove distant references, pin essential sources or raise the budget.
warning_NEARBY_CHAPTER_CONTEXT_UNAVAILAB: No nearby chapter text is available. Distant chapters were not treated as adjacent context; explicitly select references or search terms if needed.
moreToolsHelp: Open literary tools, the director, reviews, world experiments or fact extraction when needed. Opening this menu makes no AI call.
documentChanged: The chapter changed. This tool operation was stopped. Open the tool in the current chapter.
saveBeforeToolFailed: The manuscript could not be saved yet. Finish text composition or resolve the save notice, then try again. Your edits remain in the editor.
textChangedDuringSave: The manuscript changed while saving. The tool did not use the older version. Save the current edits before continuing.
reviewContextThenContinue: Review the material available to this task. Approval returns to your selected tool without starting an AI request.
contextDestination: Next: {{destination}}. Review and approve the source scope below first.
saveFactReviewFirst: Save the current fact review before opening another record or extracting new facts.
contextChangedBeforeContinue: The manuscript changed during approval. The review record was kept. Refresh the context before continuing; no AI request was started.
candidateSaved: Draft saved for later; not adopted
candidateStale: The source changed. Your draft is retained and cannot overwrite it; compare again or download the candidate.
candidateSaveFirst: The candidate has not been saved. Resolve conflicts and save first; downloading a copy does not replace saving or an explicit discard confirmation.
candidateCloseHelp: This candidate has unsaved edits. Save and close or continue editing. Discarding drops only unsaved changes; previously saved drafts remain.
chapterWorkHelp: Goals, candidates, tasks and evidence for the current manuscript. This information is not automatically sent to AI.
noChapterGoal: No goal recorded; you can write freely.
planNotFact: Outlines and plans are not committed story facts.
noChapterCandidates: No pending candidates for this chapter.
noChapterEvidence: No linked evidence yet. Add links from a manuscript selection.
scopeSourceCount: Using {{included}} bounded sources; {{excluded}} sources are not included.
scopeApprovedRecheck: You approved this scope. Source versions will be checked again before execution.
scopeReviewNeeded: Review the sources below before approving this scope.
scopeNeverAll: The whole novel is not read by default. Plans, assumptions and committed facts keep separate labels.
candidateReadFailed: Could not read the saved candidate; this window is retained
candidateManualSave: This local copy is retained and autosave is paused. Compare it, then save explicitly; this never adopts manuscript text.
candidateIncomingHelp: A newer saved version or handled status exists. Your local input is retained; compare before choosing.
candidateRecoveryHelp: Loading does not change the manuscript. Local recovery lasts until this comparison closes; download copies you want to keep. Check history for actual adopted text of handled records.
candidateLoadStored: Load stored state and keep local recovery
candidateHandledHelp: This candidate has been handled and cannot be adopted or saved again. Download the local text if needed; check history for the actual adopted text.
candidateCloseConflict: Another stored version was found. Continue editing to inspect the conflict and download local copies you need. Save-and-leave is blocked until it is resolved.
candidateContextNeedsReview: Added as a draft reference, not Canon. Review and approve the context before generating.
savedCandidateHistoryHelp: These are candidate drafts retained before the decision and may include edits that were not adopted. The decision receipt records actual adoption. Viewing these snapshots never changes the manuscript.
readOnlyComparisonHelp: The left side is the original snapshot; the right side is the selected historical candidate. This view cannot overwrite the current manuscript. Saved author text and notes are listed separately in the read-only record.
candidateRecoveryUnsaved: This view still holds unsaved local input. It remains protected until you restore or explicitly discard it; the stored version is not overwritten automatically.
candidateKeepStored: Discard local copy and keep stored version
candidateRecoveryCloseHelp: The retained local copy is unsaved. Downloading does not save it into the project or remove the exit guard. Return to resolve it, or explicitly discard it before leaving; the stored version is unchanged.
candidateRecoveryReadonlyHelp: Another window handled this candidate. Your unsaved local input remains protected and can be downloaded; it cannot be saved or adopted again. Explicitly discard it before closing or switching.
candidateResolveRecovery: Restore and save the retained copy, or download what you need and explicitly discard it, before opening another candidate or starting a new task.
candidateTaskBusy: A selection task is still running. Wait for it to finish or stop it first.
candidateOpenBlocked: The current candidate has unsaved input. Save it, or explicitly discard it through the close confirmation before opening another candidate or starting a new task.
candidateReadPending: The current candidate is still loading or being checked. Wait for it to finish, or close the comparison first.
candidateOpenScopeChanged: The candidate no longer belongs to this project or chapter and was not loaded.
selectionQueueWaiting: Waiting to submit the selected-text task…
selectionSubmitting: Local request sent; waiting for a task receipt…
selectionPreparationCancelled: Preparation cancelled. No model task was started.
selectionPreparationChanged: The manuscript, selection, context or model changed. No model task was started; review the current scope and start again.
selectionReceiptUnclear: No task receipt yet; the task may have started. Check task history before submitting again.
selectionRequestPending: A selected-text request is already waiting for a receipt. Resolve it first.
selectionPreparationTimedOut: Selected-text preparation timed out without an automatic retry. Check the current task records before starting again.
selectionStopUnclear: The real task receipt arrived, but its stop request is unconfirmed. Check the current task status in history.
selectionHistoryUnsaved: The task started, but its character-owned history could not be persisted. Check the existing task before starting another.
